recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait featuring two individuals in an intimate embrace, dominated by a monochromatic warm orange-red color palette. The primary subject's face is cropped tightly, showing eyes, nose, and mouth, while a second person's head rests against their cheek in the lower right foreground. The lighting is soft and directional, creating deep shadows and a smooth, glowing skin texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight cropping creates a sense of immediate proximity and vulnerability.
The monochromatic warm hue unifies the two subjects into a single emotional space.
Small, clean typography provides a sharp contrast to the soft, organic forms of the faces.
coreInvariants: Soft-focus background and shallow depth of field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male face occupies 80% of the frame, centered but cropped at the forehead and chin. The female subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, partially obscuring the male's jawline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the central subject, which are sharpest in focus and look directly at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the central eyes, down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then following the curve of the second subject's head back up to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with facial features, using the soft-focus skin as a textural background for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep umber and black (shadows and facial hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with low value in the shadows to create depth without introducing cool tones.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in a mid-tone area for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with generous letter-spacing to maintain a minimalist, sophisticated feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif structure.
Provides a similar classical all-caps feel with sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail, extreme close-up photograph of a man's face with a woman's head resting on his cheek. Apply a heavy warm orange-red monochromatic filter. Use soft, directional lighting to emphasize skin texture and create deep shadows. The focus should be sharpest on the eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in the middle-right section using a white, high-contrast serif font in all caps with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm (orange/red/brown)?
Is the crop tight enough to exclude the top of the head?
Is the text small, white, and elegantly spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red color cast
Amount of letter spacing in the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes are the primary focal point.
Check that the red tint does not blow out facial details.
Verify the text is legible against the skin tone.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the tight crop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up + Monochromatic Warm Filter + Wide-tracked Serif Typography = Intimate Soul Aesthetic
